name: Molly Moves On
source:
This game is about a number of magical girls talking shit, smoking weed and sitting down in heartfelt scenes you can only have with your best friend when you're about to hit 30. Now that’s magical!

[From [url=https://itch.io/jam/magical-girl-game-jam-7/rate/1970184]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏讲述一群魔法少女的故事：她们胡扯、抽大麻，在即将迈入30岁时，与最好的朋友坐下来，分享只有彼此才能拥有的真挚时刻。这才叫魔法！

[摘自[url=https://itch.io/jam/magical-girl-game-jam-7/rate/1970184]itch.io[/url]]
